## What does this change?

## Type
- [ ] New shader(s)
- [ ] Shader fix / tuning
- [ ] CLI / tooling
- [ ] Docs / website / Nix

## Checks
- [ ] `python3 -m ghostfx validate` passes
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Ran `ghostfx build --all --preset-files --manifest` (generated files committed)
- [ ] For shaders: tested in Ghostty (`ghostfx preview <id> --window`), screenshot attached
- [ ] For shaders: subtle / balanced / cinematic and `--reduced-motion` look right
- [ ] Original work, or third-party code is MIT-compatible and credited in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
